title: Michael made to undress for examination by base personnel

tellings.quote: I had to be in a room with a bunch of men undressed

plain: A former Air Force man named Michael Johnson says that after the 1977 incident he went through, base staff at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota made him undress to be examined. He tells Michels he "had to be in a room with a bunch of men undressed", and he describes it as a humiliating part of how the base handled what happened.
